title: Ulavuthurai
desc: Vasanth Periyasamy, a naval officer, is assigned to investigate the mysterious deaths at the sea. To protect his family, he assumes the identity of a car driver.

title: Sri Vinayagar Vijayam
desc: Follow the life and incredible story of Lord Ganesha from his childhood to his divinity, recounting famous mythological events that lead to his rise as a revered deity and remover of obstacles.

title: Kasi
desc: Having endured years of blindness and the hardships that accompanied it, a visually impaired musician is tricked into believing that a physician can restore his sight.

title: Diwan
desc: A cook falls in love with a wealthy man's daughter. However, after receiving her father's disparaging remarks, he embraces the challenge to amass a fortune within a year.
